intro:
[A Double Dose of Blue Terror in an Abandoned, Rain-Slicked School]
The latest installment in the legendary horror franchise, A
description:
Uncover the mystery while fleeing for your life! A pulse-pounding puzzle-horror action-adventure!
This time, the stage is set in a school, featuring two massive, star-studded scenarios!

■ Aooni 2
Years ago, a school was abruptly shuttered, left to rot.
Looking for a thrill, Hiroshi, Takuro, Takeshi, and Mika break in for a test of courage—
only to blackout and wake up trapped inside a makeshift prison cell...
To their surprise, they are joined by their teacher, who had spotted them sneaking in and followed them inside...

Will they find a way to escape this desolate school alive?!

● The classic Speed Mode returns with a maddening new option: "17x Speed"!
Customize your challenge by choosing any multiplier from 2x all the way up to 17x!
Push your reflexes to the absolute limit!


■ Brand-New Scenario: Aooni -Seaside School-
Hiroshi and the gang head to the coast for their summer seaside school trip.
Driven by the classic summer urge for adventure after hearing rumors of a monster lurking in an abandoned school near their lodge, they decide to sneak inside the school after dark...

Mysterious silhouettes, school chimes echoing through empty hallways...
And a terrifying horde of never-before-seen, mutated monsters...

What is the dark truth behind the incident that once shook this school?
Separated from the group, Hiroshi begins his desperate search to find his friends.

● Chart your own path to survival!
Conquer four distinct stages in any order you choose!
The difficulty scales depending on the path you take.
 Find your optimal route and turn the odds in your favor!

● A diverse lineup of unique Aooni awaits!!
Encounter a multitude of brand-new Aooni species!
Could some of these monstrosities even take the form of twisted sea creatures...?!
